whole_original_window_observations.cross_window_policy: Overlapping packet crops remain separate original nominations. No body is promoted or repaired by overlap, no shared physical counts inferred.
whole_original_window_observations.source_uncertainties: All local unresolved constructions, clipped strokes, marks, residuals and grouping uncertainty retained. Rejected nomination parents and their content were not supplied or read; none is erased, accepted or reconstructed here.
limitations: Source-selected windows do not establish global blindness or independent control accuracy.
Whole-face survey, address presence, edge completeness and source-to-crop provenance are not independently verified.
Approximate local body contexts include background/possible neighboring ink; not certified segmentation.
Same-owner complete construction remains provisional, and uncertain fork/curl/cap or G08-return distinctions remain masked.
Atlas class proposals are graphical hypotheses only, including those with null physical count.
